annotations.text:
Top header + tabs, sidebar removed.
The chart tabs used to exist in BOTH the sidebar and the chart card — now there is one tab bar, in the header, with a sliding underline.

Tufte-lean chart: transparent plot, horizontal grid only, no y-axis line, tick marks dropped.
The below-zero region is shaded because "inverted" is the whole point of this chart.

Press any control on this sheet — the motion is live, not drawn.
Also carries two colour findings from the palette validator that predate this redesign.
